observations: The three seal objects have no native map markers.
One seal was already broken when the v0.8.0 diagnostic first observed the chest (keysUsed=1).
Two subsequent OnKeyBroken-before callbacks reported keysUsed=1 and keysUsed=2, corresponding to the remaining two seals being broken during the test.
Parent-level keysUsed is therefore not sufficient to identify the exact surviving seal after reload; v0.8.1 adds runeIndex and runeVisual.IsEnabled diagnostics.
